name: BSP_CameraPath_SampleWorld
evidence: Calls complete local sampler, captures actual +14 pose and refreshes canonical +C8/+CC if dirty, homogeneous float4 transform and rounded reciprocal-W position writes; re-reads +14 for optional unnormalized direction transform. name: BSP_ClassId49_IsKindOf
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Class test in vtable slot 5Ch for class id 49h. Decoded from the raw .text bytes (Ghidra has no function here): MOV EAX,[ESP+4], a run of CMP EAX,imm over the ancestor chain 49 02 01 00 with the root compare emitted as TEST EAX,EAX, then CMP EAX,[ECX+0C4h] for the dynamic class id, RET 4 returning 0 or 1. Installed in vtable(s) 00D054D0. Parent id 02. No class-name literal was found for this id. See docs/ENTITY_CLASS_IDS.md.

name: BSP_EmptyOneArgVirtualStub
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_ai_attackmove_substates, read-only analysis. No Ghidra function starts here; body 007B3DD0-007B3DD2 inclusive, the three bytes C2 04 00 = RET 4, followed by CC padding to 007B3DDF. __thiscall(this)(4 bytes of args) that does nothing. Twenty vtables reference it, so it is a COMDAT-folded empty virtual shared across classes, NOT an attackmove routine: 00D2171C+0Ch (the attackmove sub-state at state+14F4h) is only one of them. It is also never usefully stepped, because 009E8820 runs the selector (009E88D8) before the member step (009E88F0) and the negative seed at state+1500h makes the first selector call re-pick. Boundary evidence and the other nineteen vtables in docs/SHIP_AI_ATTACKMOVE_SUBSTATES.md

name: BSP_UnitInstance_RetireAiSubNodes
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_loose_ends_1, read-only analysis. __thiscall void(Unit* this), body 007B9590-007B95D7, plain RET. Clears byte unit+520h, then for unit+DF4h and unit+6DCh in turn: if non-null, calls the sub-node's vtable slot +10h and nulls the field. For the gunnery pass (vtable 00D0D360) slot +10h is the gun-bot base stub 0071C4A0, which only sets subnode+10h=1 and subnode+11h=0, so this retires rather than frees; BSP_TickElement_RunSubNodes 008759B0 deletes the retired sub-node on the node's next tick (008759E1 tests subnode+10h, 00875A5A calls slot 0 with PUSH 1). Tail-calls 00951FB0, which clears [this+4A4h] and tail-calls 00779AF0 BSP_MissionEntity_OnKilledPlayerUnit with the same this, so this is an override of that virtual on a unit-derived class; unit+520h corroborates (docs/TICK_ELEMENT_OVERRIDES.md). Installed in nine vtables: 00D000F0, 00D00388, 00D05FA0, 00D066B8, 00D069A0, 00D0BB00, 00D19DA8, 00D1A080, 00D1A358; the slot index is NOT settled. Corrects docs/UNIT_DESTRUCTOR_LEVELS.md's claim that nothing outside the release chain touches unit+6DCh.

name: BSP_Plane_LatchControlInput

name: BSP_Math_HeadingToDirectionXZ
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_unit_message_arms, read-only analysis. float3* __thiscall(float3* out, float heading), body 007BA2E0-007BA339, x87. Computes a = [00CE3830] - heading, adds [00CE3828] when the result is negative, and writes cos a, 0, sin a to out, so the y component is always zero and this is a horizontal heading-to-direction conversion. Called at 008222DA in the kind 9Dh MT_SHIP_TORPEDOGENERATE_HACK arm, where the result becomes the spawn direction.

name: BSP_Matrix_GetMaximumBasisLengthSquared
evidence: [BSP reconstruction] For rows0/1/2, x87 computes x*x, y*y, combines ySquared+xSquared, then adds z*z and stores completed sum float. FCOMI/JC selects between rows0/1, then FCOMIP/JC compares selected row to row2. Carry includes unordered; equality retains earlier row. Ignores last column and translation. Native max-row rule, not spectral norm. Typed implementation retains instruction and float-store order. Original ABI: ECX=16-float matrix; x87 ST0=float result reloaded from float storage; RET. Evidence: docs/MODEL_WORLD_BOUNDS.md; reports/model_world_bounds_audit.json. Descriptive names are hypotheses; typed C++ interfaces are not native ABI or game validation.

name: BSP_Plane_QuantizeControlAxes
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_plane_flight, read-only analysis. __thiscall(unit, const float* axes), Ghidra body 007BB6E0-007BB91E, called from 007BB920, itself called from the plane tick at 007CE865. Round-trips each control axis through a signed byte so a locally flown plane and a replicated one see the same input: q = ftol(v*127.0 [00CFD408] + 128.5 [00D05998]); q >= 0FFh gives 1.0f, q <= 1 gives -1.0f, otherwise (q - 128)/127, stored back into unit+9E4h..+9F4h. partial: the first axis in full, the other four by repetition at 007BB730 and 007BB763. docs/PLANE_FLIGHT.md

name: BSP_PlaneEntity_ApplyHitRecord
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_ship_hit_record, read-only analysis. Was BSP_UnitInstance_OnHit, which named the wrong class. 007BBCF0 is the vtable[ECh] hit handler of class id 0F (00D05F20) and the eight plane classes under it: 10 MPlaneBomber, 11 MPlaneTorpedoBomber, 12 MPlaneDiveBomber, 13 MPlaneFighter, 14 MReconPlane, 15 MSmallReconPlane, 16 MLargeReconPlane, 17 MPlaneKamikaze. Nine vtables (00D00070, 00D00308, 00D05F20, 00D06638, 00D06920, 00D0BA80, 00D19D28, 00D1A000, 00D1A2D8), from scanning .rdata for the address and subtracting ECh; every base is one docs/ENTITY_CLASS_IDS.md already names. The unit instance vtable 00CFC3D0 that docs/UNIT_INSTANCE_LAYOUT.md gives for MDestroyer carries 00826F10 at +ECh instead, so no ship hit reaches this body. Body and internals unchanged from docs/UNIT_HIT_PATH.md. docs/SHIP_HIT_RECORD.md.

name: BSP_Plane_BindCrashEffect
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_projectile_helpers, read-only analysis. __fastcall void(Plane* p = ECX), plain RET at 007BC548, body 007BC4E0-007BC548. Returns immediately when the cached handle [p+0AA4h] or the byte [p+0AA8h] is already set (007BC4E6, 007BC4EF), so it binds at most one effect per plane. Refreshes the pose through 00414DB0 when [p+0C8h] is clear (007BC4F8), takes a direction from p->vtable[34h](&local) at 007BC512, then 0084B6F0([[p+730h]+24h], p+0FCh, direction) at 007BC524 - p+730h is the UNIT class descriptor, so its +24h is not the weapon descriptor's +24h. Stores the handle at 007BC52B, InterlockedIncrement on handle+4h at 007BC537 and sets the flag at 007BC53D. Sole call site 0084C34B in 0084BF00, whose receiver EBP is [shot+0CCh] and only when that object answers IsKindOf(0Fh), the plane base: this is the plane branch of the shared sweep, reached from 007C0910. docs/PROJECTILE_HELPERS.md

name: aircraft_deactivate_sibling_007bcaa0
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_loose_ends_1, read-only analysis. __thiscall void(Unit* this), body 007BCAA0-007BCB27 (plain RET at 007BCB27, int3 padding after). Ghidra has no function here; FUN_007bca50's body ends at 007BCA98. Installed at 00D000EC, the vtable slot immediately before 007B9590 at 00D000F0. Partial coverage: the tail 007BCAF0-007BCB27 was read and is the same retire-and-drop as 007B95B5, i.e. for unit+DF4h then unit+6DCh call the sub-node's vtable slot +10h (the stub 0071C4A0) and null the field. The head 007BCAA0-007BCAEF was not read beyond its shape: it stores a float at [this+C14h] from 00BD2F10 over the globals 00E18714/00E18718, copies [this+1B0h] into [this+748h] unless it equals 8, calls 00959450 with this, and calls 007F3970(this, 0) when [this+9D4h] is non-null.
